name: Cow
source:
Hero is a pharmacist who follows his father's steps who is a president of a pharmaceutical company. Of course, he's not interested in the current work. So in the end father suddenly requests a certain job from the hero - to train sex slaves for Tachibana play. What's with this play and why is he chosen trainer?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-january-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
男主是一名药剂师，追随父亲的脚步，而他的父亲是制药公司的总裁。当然，他对眼下的工作并不感兴趣。

于是，父亲突然向男主提出了一项特殊任务——为橘的性奴训练游戏培养训练师。

这个游戏究竟是什么？为什么偏偏选中了他来当训练师？

[来自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-january-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
